summary: Revised plan.md after the red team (O19). The Day-30 goal is now activated trials in closed cohorts, and $95 MRR moves to the next window. Added a closed-beta gate and an interview gate before any launch. PH defaults to Tue Dec 8; Nov 17 only if both gates pass by Fri Nov 13. Kill triggers are re-timed, and Pro-vs-Free (G01 #4) blocks pricing and trial-email approval. 3 new tasks (G39-G41). Edits to existing tasks G01, G02, G05, G11, G15-G17, G28, G32, G33 and G36, plus deferral of G22 and G31, are listed in plan.md §13b; the main session must apply them, because apply-results cannot edit existing tasks. No domain yet, so all live-site work is pending. Test product: nothing is published.

experiments.hypothesis: If the beta and interview gates pass, the public launch week (Product Hunt plus launch platforms plus directories; Nov 17 or default Dec 8) produces more than half of all trial starts in the 14 days after launch.
experiments.metric: share of trial_started by utm_source in launch week vs the following 7 days

experiments.hypothesis: Trials started in the closed beta and the first public launch convert to at least 5 paid Pro (or Team-equivalent) subscriptions, $95 MRR, within the next 30-day window (Dec 3 - Jan 1).
experiments.metric: subscription_started count and MRR on 2027-01-01; trial-to-paid over trials whose 14 days have ended

experiments.hypothesis: A closed beta of 5-10 warm-network users, invited by the owner's hand-sent notes, yields at least 5 non-owner users who each send one real proposal (with signature and deposit request) by Fri 2026-11-13.
experiments.metric: count of beta users with proposal_sent (utm_campaign=2026-11-beta); first closed 7-day cohort activation

experiments.hypothesis: The beachhead (solo freelance designers and developers) sends more than 3 proposals a month, so the Free cap of 3 leaves room for Pro.
experiments.metric: median proposals sent per month across interviewees (G41); after launch, plan_limit_reached as a share of active free users

new_tasks.title: Trial-window forecast from the owner's real go-live date
new_tasks.brief: Inputs: plan.md §7 and §8, reports/red-team.md Risk 1, reports/owner-decisions.md (go-live date for signup plus billing tested end to end, warm-network ICP count), metrics/kpi-tree.md. Model paid subscriptions by Wed 2026-12-02 as trial-eligible days (trials starting on or before Nov 18) x expected trials per day x trial-to-paid at 10% and 20%, plus a scenario for PH on Nov 17 vs Dec 8. Label every input as owner-supplied or assumption. Recommend whether the $95 MRR goal can return to Day 30 (only if 5 or more paid at 10%). Output: metrics/trial-window-forecast.md. No numbers go into copy.

new_tasks.title: Closed beta protocol and end-to-end proposal test (beta gate)
new_tasks.brief: Inputs: research/activation-plan.md, outbox/outreach/warm-network.md, research/risks.md T3, T8 and the go/no-go checklist, reports/owner-decisions.md, claims.md. Write the closed-beta protocol for 5-10 people from the owner's warm network: owner pre-test (one real proposal with signature and deposit request to a test client, screen-recorded), invite waves, the beta user checklist (sign up, create, send one real proposal to a real client), a feedback form, a bug-triage rule, and the gate check for Fri 2026-11-13 (at least 5 non-owner users each sent one real proposal). Also the first-closed-cohort activation check. Wording says 'deposit request' only, never 'legally binding'. Output: research/closed-beta-plan.md. Any message to beta users is drafted in outbox/beta/ and listed as a send approval; send nothing.

new_tasks.title: Interview synthesis and launch-gate verdict
new_tasks.brief: Inputs: research/interview-kit.md, the owner's interview notes (first 10 by Thu 2026-11-12), research/icp.md, research/positioning.md, reports/red-team.md Risks 2 and 3. Tally: how many of the first 10 describe the brief-to-proposal-to-deposit gap as a current pain (gate: 3 or more); proposals sent last month and the month before (median, and whether it is 3 or fewer, which triggers the Free-cap decision); what they would pay for beyond volume; current tools. Give a pass/fail verdict per gate for the Fri 2026-11-13 review. Quote no one without consent; no names in outputs. Output: research/interview-synthesis.md. If interview notes are missing, mark the gate 'pending' and do not guess.
